title: Regime-Based World Modeling: A Layered Epistemic Architecture for Complex Systems
abstract: Generalizes the EBE regime architecture beyond physics to biology, economics, and AI. Introduces the (R, L) coordinate system for regime classification, regime-gating mechanisms, driver proximity analysis, and validity domains as a cross-domain epistemic framework for complex systems.

efc_context.regime_relevance: Cross-domain regime architecture generalizing EBE to biology, economics, and AI

key_results: (R, L) coordinate system for regime classification across domains
Driver proximity metric for causal attribution
Formal validity domains applicable to physics, biology, economics, and AI
